description: This is a middleware implementation for a FastAPI web application that enforces JWT authentication on all HTTP requests, with specific exemptions for certain endpoints such as registration, login, API docs, and an emoji upload endpoint that can accept either a JWT or a static admin token.

classes.name: AuthRequiredMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class that enforces JWT authentication on incoming HTTP requests, allowing specific exemptions and handling special cases like emoji upload.

methods.name: __init__(self, app: ASGIApp)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the middleware with the application and sets exemption paths, prefixes, and admin upload token.

methods.name: dispatch(self, request: Request, call_next: Callable)
methods.description: Main middleware method that processes each incoming request, checks for exemptions, verifies tokens, and determines whether to allow the request or respond with an unauthorized error.

methods.name: JSONResponse _unauthorized_response(message: str)
methods.description: Helper method that returns a JSON response with a 401 status code and an error message when authentication fails.

ctags.name: dispatch
ctags.pattern: /^    async def dispatch(self, request: Request, call_next: Callable):$/
